description:
ZORT connects your online store's inventory and order data to ChatGPT. If you sell on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, LINE, Facebook, or your own storefront and manage everything in ZORT, you can now ask questions about your business in plain language and get answers from your live data.

Check today's sales and see which channel performed best. Find your best-selling products for any period. See which items are likely to run out of stock soon based on recent sales. Look up real-time stock by product or warehouse, find orders and track their shipping status, and review purchase orders, quotations, returns, and customer contacts.

You sign in with your own ZORT account, and ChatGPT only sees data that account can access. The plugin is read-only: it can look up and analyze your data but cannot create, edit, or delete anything in ZORT.

defaultPrompt: What are my best-selling products this month?
Check the current stock levels of my products.
